what: the decode ledger, all arms, PRIMARY bank

refc-base-30k.unit_note: DECODES are decoder forward passes over candidates. REFINE-EVALS are closed-form geometric transforms of an ALREADY-DECODED (4,2) array (scale and/or rotate). They are NOT the same currency and this ledger never converts between them.
refc-base-30k.latency_note: LATENCY IS NOT THE WIN. INHERITED (fan-width, MEASURED on Thor): 2.78x fewer decodes is worth 6.5 % end-to-end on XL / 3.3 % on base, because the decoder is only 28.2 % of the frame and is fixed-cost dominated. This ledger is BUDGET REALLOCATION, not speed.

⭐ CURRENCY MISMATCH (prereg outcome O-E).consequence: the shipped selector emits ONE logit PER ANCHOR. It is a function of the anchor index, not of a trajectory, so it CANNOT score a point that is not in the fan. Freed DECODES therefore cannot be spent on the off-fan operator without a TRAJECTORY-CONDITIONED scorer, which no amount of freed decode budget provides.
